title: Manifest
excerpt: Compare 183 AI infrastructure tools and work out which stack your use case actually needs. From Augmentor Labs.
content_html:
How to read this. Fit scores are a scoring heuristic, not a benchmark. They encode which constraints rule a tool out and which answers suit it — a starting point for the argument, not the end of it. Brand marks are the official SVGs from the simple-icons project (CC0), inlined into the page — shown nominatively to identify each tool. Microsoft, AWS and Azure marks are not distributed by that project, so those tools keep a lettermark.
